Name: Glass Memory
Description: A broken shard that reflects who you were, not who you are.

Name: Eternal Candle
Description: Burns in defiance of darkness. Comforts the soul.

Name: Bone Charm
Description: Strung together from something that used to laugh.

Name: Memory Tome
Description: Pages filled with words you didn’t write but remember anyway.

Name: Muted Stone
Description: Warm and silent, like holding someone’s last word.
Effect: Prevents sanity loss at Whispering Wound.

Name: Choral Thread
Description: A delicate thread vibrating with half-remembered songs.
Effect: Reveals a tile if used while resting.

Name: Rib Key
Description: Opens doors made of bone and bad intentions.

Name: Echo Stone
Description: Whispers what lies beneath the next tile.

Name: Vein Map
Description: Pulses when near secrets.

Name: Crown of Loss
Description: It fits perfectly. You lose yourself a little more.

Name: Withered Apple
Description: Tastes like regret. Heals like forgiveness.

Name: Paper Tongue
Description: Translates feelings into warnings.

Name: Whisper Link
Description: A psychic tether to someone who still matters.

Name: Singing Blade
Description: Hums lullabies when blood touches it.

Name: Saltroot Bandage
Description: Stings. Then soothes.

Name: Signal Crown
Description: Worn by those who still listen.

Name: Tearshard
Description: Molten glass cooled by your shame.

Name: Painted Memory
Description: Stares back with your eyes.

Name: Mourning Veil
Description: Softens the impact of loss.

Name: Face of Another
Description: They won’t know it’s you. You might forget too.

Name: Regret Seed
Description: Can grow back what you destroyed.

Name: Rusty Band
Description: A broken promise looped in iron.

Name: Echo Thread
Description: Tangles with forgotten speech.

Name: Oracle Wick
Description: Burns fate for truth.

Name: Splintered Mask
Description: Lies better than you ever could.
